# Checklist — XREAL / Viture

**Product honesty:** The intended eyes-up path today is **mirroring** your phone or computer display to the glasses. SPECTOR is not a native XREAL/Viture app.

Time: ~30–45 minutes. Reply by email using the feedback headings you were sent.

---

## Setup

1. Note exact glasses model (+ firmware if known).  
2. Open SPECTOR on phone or computer: https://www.spectorlabs.io → player.  
3. Start your usual mirror / desktop stream to the glasses.  
4. Confirm you can see the SPECTOR player in the glasses FOV.

---

### A. Mirror path

| # | Task | Pass? | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-------|
| A1 | SPECTOR visible in glasses via mirror | | |
| A2 | Text readable at Normal / Presentation | | |
| A3 | Lag / blur / cutoff acceptable? | | |

### B. Comfort and motion

| # | Task | Pass? | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-------|
| B1 | **Comfort** mode with gentle head movement | | |
| B2 | **Focus** mode for a stable read | | |
| B3 | Speaking while mirrored (~2 minutes) | | |

### C. Controls and long scripts

| # | Task | Pass? | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-------|
| C1 | Play/pause from phone/computer while mirrored | | |
| C2 | Any glasses hardware controls affecting SPECTOR? | Yes / No | |
| C3 | Longer script (~5+ minutes) stays usable | | |

Results are **tester-reported** until promoted to **verified** in official docs.
